He was always productive, especially in the red zone, but now he has the chance to be the RB1 for the Texans. highlights: Even if you are not the biggest Allen fan, it is difficult to argue against the four-time Pro Bowler having significantly more arm talent than Shough. Jahmyr Gibbs Over 90.5 Rushing Yards (-110) There is plenty of talent across this Lions’ offense, but it has become increasingly evident that Jahmyr Gibbs is the foundation of the attack. After splitting carries with David Montgomery to start his career, Detroit now leans on the Alabama product as their bell-cow back. Gibbs tallied a career-high and NFL-leading 29 carries in Week 1, turning these opportunities into 156 yards and two touchdowns. Buffalo holds plenty of defensive concerns of their own entering this matchup.

Lions vs. Bills NFL Player Prop Bets and Picks for Thursday Night Football Week 2 of NFL action kicks off with a thrilling Thursday Night Football battle between the Detroit Lions and the Buffalo Bills. Both teams have deep playoff aspirations and picked up Week 1 victories. The Bills fended off the Texans 36-31, while the Lions were pushed to the limit in a 31-30 overtime victory against the Saints. They will now square off in a measuring stick matchup against each other to kick off the second week of the season. Looking at the odds, the Bills enter as 5.5-point favorites with -230 Moneyline odds on DraftKings Sportsbook. The Lions hold +190 odds to pull off the upset, with the game total set at 54.5 points. But there are plenty of ways to get involved in the action beyond backing a side or total. Let’s take a look at my top three favorite player props for the Week 2 Thursday Night Football matchup. But the impressive output should say more about Allen than the Texans’ defense. The Bills’ star had a bit of a down season last year in his passing metrics, averaging 215.8 passing yards per game. But he is averaging 235.9 passing yards per game in his career and tallied as many as 284.0 over a season. Allen still tallied 253 passing yards or greater in seven games ,even with it being a down year in passing production last year. Allen will also be able to feast on this Lions’ defense, given the concerns mentioned above.
